SELECT fiscal_year, MIN(calendar_date) mn, MAX(calendar_date) mx, MIN(fiscal_week) w1, MAX(fiscal_week) w2, COUNT(*) n
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter=3 GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) n_distinct, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_ids, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) net_sales, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=n.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) v FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2

ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, ROUND(m.v,2) mine, ROUND(c.c,2) ctl, ROUND(m.v-c.c,2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.v,0)-COALESCE(c.c,0))>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
quarterly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 3 AS fiscal_quarter, ty.region,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM quarterly ty
JOIN quarterly ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ty.region = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, ty.region

SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_quarter=3 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
